name: com.lingkyn.locomotion.unity
description: ScriptableObject binding of locomotion mode identity to XR Interaction Toolkit locomotion providers and the tunneling vignette controller, with fail-closed binding validation and stable codes, an injectable ILocomotionProviderSurface seam, and a plain runtime constructed with explicit references that applies an accepted comfort policy to the bound providers, forwards accepted intents in order, and reports every by-name or optional resolution failure, for the Lingkyn Locomotion Core.
